title: Beal Conjecture — Opera Numerorum — v9.3.0 J0(26) decomposition
description: Reproducible J0(26) decomposition evidence for the Beal Conjecture formalization. The certificate records dim J0(26) = 2 = 1 + 1, the reported isogeny J0(26) ~ E26a1 x E26b1, and the exact coefficient models (1,0,1,-5,-8) and (1,-1,1,-3,3). Sage decomposition semantics and mwrank/second-descent rank semantics remain explicit proposition-valued premises in Lean rather than global axioms.
